description: Tracks which OSRS wiki pages have been compared to Scape. Future wiki-comparison agents should read this FIRST and skip any page already listed. After an agent compares new pages, it appends them here with the report_file that cites the comparison.

comparison_reports.summary: Per-category gap analysis across 10 major content areas (quests, methods, bestiary, bosses, items, minigames, diaries, CAs, coll log, transportation). Scape ahead on quests (+29%), diaries (+10%), Aelgard-unique minigames. Behind on bestiary (7%), equipment (36%), coll-log items (49%), teleports (49%).

Extended OSRS hiscores snapshot: 23 skills + Overall, 46 bosses (agent A covers the other 23), 6 clue tiers, 7 minigames. Six rank samples (p1/p100/p1000/p10000/p100000/p500000) per category. 498 samples total, 89.8% populated (remaining 10.2% null where OSRS ladder does not extend to that depth). Stickiest bosses: The Whisperer, The Leviathan, CoX:CM. Quick-quit bosses: Amoxliatl, Callisto, Sol Heredit.

quests.note: Subset of OSRS's ~170 quests — HTTrack crawl incomplete at time of scan

minigames.note: Includes some overflow beyond OSRS's ~49 canonical minigames
